title: Vertiv Exceeds First Quarter Guidance and Reports Net Sales Increase of 5.3%, Orders Growth of 34%
summary: End-market demand continued to be strong with first quarter 2022 orders up 34% from last years first quarter and record-high backlog of $4.1 billion
